en.title: China Private Transfer or Public Transport: Which Is Worth It?
en.headline: Private Transfer or Public Transport in China: When Is the Extra Cost Worth It?
en.description: Choose a private transfer, public transport or a hybrid for one China airport or station segment by testing bags, mobility, operating hours and missed-connection consequences.
en.heroAlt: Editorial diagram comparing a staffed vehicle pickup, a direct public transport line and a hybrid transfer.

zh.title: 中国接送车还是公共交通：额外费用何时值得？

zh.description: 针对一个机场或车站地面段，从行李、行动能力、运营时间和误接后果判断接送车、公共交通或混合方案。
zh.heroAlt: 原创决策图，对比有人接车、直达公共交通和混合接驳三条路线。
